# KeikoArts (keikoartist.com)

> KeikoArts is Keiko's VTuber art and Live2D studio: original anime VTuber models drawn from scratch and rigged in Live2D, ready for VTube Studio, plus PNGTubers, emotes, banners, logos and stream assets. Style: cute meets gothic. 200+ commissions completed. Prices in USD; 13% tax is added on every invoice. Every commission is done within 3 weeks.

## How to order
- Order form with live total: https://keikoartist.com/?order=VTuber (all services: https://keikoartist.com/#services)
- Payment: PayPal (card or PayPal balance), in full, 50/50, or 3 parts for orders above $150
- Questions before ordering: Discord https://discord.gg/FbgWxMPjf or the live chat on the website (usually replies within 6 hours, WIB / GMT+7)
- Merch / commercial rights: +$30 for any service. Rush delivery: +25%.

## Prices
- Live2D VTuber model: Bust · Art only $100; Half body · Art only $150; Full body · Art only $250; Bust · Art + Rig $150; Half body · Art + Rig $250; Full body · Art + Rig $400; Bust · Rig only $100; Half body · Rig only $150; Full body · Rig only $250
- VTuber model add-ons: Extra expression / toggle +$20 each; Hand toggle +$30 each; VBridger +$200; Extra outfit +$100; Extra hairstyle +$100; Commercial / merch rights +$30
- VTuber debut packages: Starter · Bust up $250; Debut · Half body $380; Full Debut · Full body $520
- PNGTuber: Bust-up $60; Thigh-up / full body $100
- Twitch / Discord emotes: Static emote $5 each; Animated emote $15 each
- Chibi VTuber: Chibi model art $45
- VTuber pet: Pet art $63; Pet art + rig $110
- Others (from): Custom PFP $36, Banner $45, VTuber Logo $30, Stream Overlay $45, Background $100
